description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git patch-id' functionality, including setup, patch ID calculation, comparison, and various test cases for verifying behavior under different scenarios.

methods.name: calc_patch_id
methods.description: Calculates the patch ID for a given patch file, outputs to a specific file, and ensures the output is a single line.

methods.name: get_top_diff
methods.description: Retrieves the top diff for specified git revisions, with specific options, and outputs to a temporary file.

methods.name: get_patch_id
methods.description: Computes the patch ID for a specific revision by getting the top diff and then calculating the patch ID.
